question: Fit a straight-line trend to monthly completed revenue from January 2024 to December 2025, using month number 1 to 24 as x. Which months fell more than 1.5 standard deviations below the trend line, using the standard deviation of the residuals, and what was each month's residual (actual minus trend, in dollars)? Label months as YYYY-MM.
plan: The question asks for a forecast, a projection or a fitted trend line: get the series it is fitted on (one row per period), fit it from that series, and report each forecast with its period.

sql_attempts.sql: WITH monthly_rev AS (SELECT SUBSTRING(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS rev FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(o.order_date, 1, 7)), numbered_months AS (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY month) AS x, month, rev, CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY month) AS REAL) AS rx FROM monthly_rev), stats AS (SELECT AVG(rx) AS mean_x, AVG(rev) AS mean_y, SUM((rx - (SELECT AVG(CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY month) AS REAL)) FROM monthly_rev)) * (rev - (SELECT AVG(rev) FROM monthly_rev))) / SUM((rx - (SELECT AVG(CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY month) AS REAL)) FROM monthly_rev)) * (rx - (SELECT AVG(CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY month) AS REAL)) FROM monthly_rev))) AS slope, AVG(rev) - (SUM((rx - (SELECT AVG(CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY month) AS REAL)) FROM monthly_rev)) * (rev - (SELECT AVG(rev) FROM monthly_rev))) / SUM((rx - (SELECT AVG(CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY month) AS REAL)) FROM monthly_rev)) * (rx - (SELECT AVG(CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY month) AS REAL)) FROM monthly_rev)))) * AVG(rx) AS intercept FROM numbered_months), residuals_calc AS (SELECT nm.month, nm.rev, (s.intercept + s.slope * nm.rx) AS trend, (nm.rev - (s.intercept + s.slope * nm.rx)) AS residual FROM numbered_months AS nm CROSS JOIN stats AS s), stddev_calc AS (SELECT SQRT(SUM(residual * residual) / COUNT(*)) AS std_dev FROM residuals_calc) SELECT rc.month, rc.residual FROM residuals_calc AS rc CROSS JOIN stddev_calc AS sd WHERE rc.residual < -1.5 * sd.std_dev ORDER BY rc.month LIMIT 500
